actions.oldValue: Rock of Ages (Brooks Atkinson Theatre, opened 2009-04-07, closed 2015-01-18). Press reports it recouped its $7.25 million capitalization, in 2012.
actions.newValue: Rock of Ages (Helen Hayes Theatre after its move from the Brooks Atkinson Theatre, opened 2009-04-07, closed 2015-01-18). Press reports it recouped its $7.25 million capitalization, in 2012.

actions.oldValue: Groundhog Day (August Wilson Theatre, opened 2017-04-17, closed 2017-09-17). No readable source states a capitalization, so none is shown.
